description: Merges sixteen stereo pairs into a left and a right polyphonic output, in 2HP

inputs.text: The left side of its pair, and with nothing patched into the right side of that pair it feeds both outputs
The right side of its pair

outputs.text: Carries the left inputs as one polyphonic cable, one channel per pair, with as many channels as the highest numbered pair whose left input has a cable
Carries the right inputs as one polyphonic cable, one channel per pair, with as many channels as the highest numbered pair whose left input has a cable

menu: Merge Poly Cables — adds up all the channels of a polyphonic input into its one channel of the output; turned off, only the first channel of that input is taken
